Zoe (ML): FYI I promoted v5-small-int8 to a micro-canary (1% traffic) at 11:00 UTC for the /contract-summarize endpoint. immediate run shows p50 improvement and cost down, but schema_field_presence dropped ~2.3% concentrated on nested bullet/list fields.

Hiro (SRE): which metric exactly and is it per-cohort or global?

Zoe (ML): schema_field_presence (field-level existence checks). cohort only: canary-D. breakdown: total requests=4.2k, global delta=-0.4%, canary delta=-0.023. nested_list slice hit rate ~12%.

Mina (Research): any config differences? decoding/temperature same?

Zoe (ML): identical decoding. suspect quantized tokenization edge when lists are long ( > 80 items) + attention-kernel path for int8. Not seen in internal shadowing with synthetic short docs.

rollout-bot: Rule detector: per-cohort schema_field_presence delta exceeded 0.02 for 6 minutes. Flagging canary-D.

Clara (Product): this endpoint is used by enterprise legal customers. Recommend isolating canary for only non-template traffic immediately.

Hiro (SRE): propose a cohort-slice holdback: if per-cohort rolling_delta(metric='schema_field_presence', window=5m) > 0.02 and slice_share('nested_list') > 0.1 then route that slice's cohort traffic to baseline variant while leaving other cohort traffic intact. Pseudo-rule: \n```\nif rolling_delta(cohort, 'schema_field_presence', 5m) > 0.02 and slice_share('nested_list') > 0.1:\n    route(cohort.slice('nested_list')) -> baseline_variant\n    notify(owners)\n```

Mina (Research): add hysteresis: require condition to hold for 2 consecutive windows or delta > 0.03 for single window to avoid noise. Also capture 30 sample diffs for the slice to help debugging.

Zoe (ML): agree. I'll kick off a focused replay of 1.2k recorded nested-list samples against int8/unquantized kernels; will attach diffs. Also let's schedule a 0.5% dedicated canary that targets nested_list slice only for the next run.

Hiro (SRE): I can implement the routing override now. ops: apply slice-holdback for cohort-D at 11:06 UTC (done). We'll keep the rest of canary traffic unchanged. add 10m cooloff and auto-revert if metric recovers below 0.01.

Clara (Product): please notify CS and surface a short status note. Also update runbook: "slice-holdback routing" and assign owner.

rollout-bot: Action created: 1769123456-slice-holdback-routing (assignee: Hiro).

Zoe (ML): replay started. early diff (n=300): nested_list_presence: baseline=0.965 -> canary=0.937 (delta -0.028). capturing examples.

Mina (Research): if replay confirms attention-kernel boundary issue, candidate fixes: increase kv-warmup tokens for long-list contexts, or use int8 fallback for a single attention op at index boundary. We'll test both.

Hiro (SRE): I'll keep monitoring the cohort. If other slices hit the 0.02 rule more than 2 times in 1h, we'll escalate to global rollback.

Zoe (ML): thanks. will post the replay bundle and proposed kernel changes in the ticket.

Clara (Product): resolved plan: (1) slice-holdback applied; (2) replay & 30-sample diffs saved; (3) targeted nested-list canary next; (4) kernel experiments; (5) postmortem if we see customer impact.

rollout-bot: Incident note saved: 1769123456-nested-list-slice-holdback.
